A little clarity

Good questions.

Are all tools really free?

Yes. This collection has no paid tier, account requirement, download gate or subscription.

Do you upload my files?

No. Images, PDFs and text are processed in your browser. AI background removal downloads its model to your device, then runs locally.

Which image formats can I convert?

You can export JPEG, PNG or WebP when supported by your browser. Import works with common browser-readable formats, including JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP and AVIF. HEIC, RAW and Photoshop files are not supported. Animated images are flattened to a single frame.

Why is background removal slower the first time?

AI mode downloads a model and runtime assets before processing. It needs an internet connection for that first download, device memory, and a modern browser. Solid-color mode is a faster local option for plain backgrounds.

Are IELTS scores official?

The overall calculator follows IELTS averaging and rounding rules. Listening and reading converters show indicative practice bands; actual raw-score boundaries can vary by test version.

Can I use the website offline?

After a successful online visit, supported browsers cache the main tool interface. Core tools work offline once cached. AI and OCR assets may need a network connection if they have not been cached.

What are the file limits?

Images are limited to 25 MB each and 24 megapixels. PDF processing is limited to 60 MB combined. Large files can still exceed the available memory on smaller devices.

How do the fun photo scores work?

The cuteness meter makes a randomized entertainment card from a photo. It does not measure beauty, personality or health. Photos stay on your device.

Can I use my camera or microphone?

On supported HTTPS browsers, use the explicit camera or recording button and choose whether to grant permission. Photo uploads are available instead of a camera. Hardware and format support vary.

How do I save a resume or invoice as PDF?

Use Print / Save PDF, then choose your browser or operating system’s PDF destination. A standalone HTML download is also available.

Are health and pregnancy results medical advice?

No. Formulas, assumptions and source links are displayed. Due dates and cycle dates are estimates, and journals do not interpret symptoms. These tools do not replace professional care.

What dates do Nepal tools support?

BS conversion covers 2000–2090, corresponding to AD 1943-04-14–2034-04-13. The holiday calendar is the sourced BS 2083 notice and shows scope restrictions.

Where did my download go?

Check your browser’s Downloads list. The file is saved using your browser’s usual download settings.

Can I host this on my own domain?

Yes. Download the source ZIP, unpack it, and upload the website files to any static host. Follow the included README and open-source license requirements.

Are these guides written by experts?

They are original practical instructions prepared with AI assistance using the tools’ behavior and linked sources. No professional review, clinical credentials or independent testing of every device is claimed. Corrections are welcome.

Is Nepocore approved by Google AdSense?

No approval is claimed. This release has no ads. Any future application depends on the publisher’s account, publicly accessible hosting, policy compliance and Google’s review. A guide count or a set of policy pages does not guarantee approval.

What limits apply to the new PDF tools?

PDF to images, text extraction and compression accept one unprotected PDF up to 30 MB. Image export supports up to 30 selected pages, text extraction up to 100 and image-based compression up to 40 pages. These limits differ from the older merge and extraction tools; use each interface’s displayed limit.
